desc:
<A:P17> is correct. No matter what happens next, Black has to stop White at A. If you start to think about what will happen if White cuts next, you may lose your nerve, so don't think; just play A. You can start thinking about White's cut after White makes it.

Middle and upper level players miss this surprisingly often and play <B:Q17> or <C:O17>, which only proves that they have not grasped the fundamentals.
